description: pg_duckdb declares PARTITIONING and CLUSTERING as supported (benchbox/platforms/pg_duckdb.py:383) but skips partitioning at execution (pg_duckdb.py:42). Decide the method for each table kind: CLUSTER and partitioning for heap tables (CLUSTER was confirmed working on a pg_duckdb plain table during the #3092 verification), and sort order on load for DuckDB-backed or Parquet-backed tables. Implement it with ledger evidence, and make the claimed tuning types match what is applied.
